content.title: Arizona basketball defeats Utah State to make March Madness Sweet 16
content.text: March 22, 2026Updated March 23, 2026, 8:01 p.m. MTThe Arizona Wildcats played their second game of the 2026 NCAA Tournament against Utah State Sunday.What was the score of the game between the No. 1 seeded Wildcats and No. 9 seeded Aggies?Who stood out for Arizona?What did we learn?Look back at our live updates of the game, which was played at Viejas Arena in San Diego, California, on March 22, 2026.Watch Arizona vs Utah State on Sling What was the Arizona vs Utah State score in March Madness?The score of the Arizona vs Utah State NCAA Tournament second-round game was Arizona 78, Utah State 66. Arizona holds off Utah State, advances to Sweet 16The Arizona Wildcats are Sweet 16 bound.Tommy Lloyd's team held off a Utah State rally in the second half on their way to a 78-66 win at Viejas Arena in San Diego, California, to advance to the regional semifinals of the NCAA Tournament.No. 1 Arizona will play No. 4 Arkansas in the West Region Sweet 16 matchup on Thursday, March 26.Jaden Bradley led the Wildcats with 18 points, including some big baskets late in the game when Utah State when making a rally against Arizona.Brayden Burries had a huge 3-pointer late to help seal the win for Arizona. He finished with 16 points.Motiejus Krivas had 14 rebounds, including nine offensive boards in a dominant rebounding effort for Arizona.Arizona had 54 rebounds. 22 of them were on the offensive glass.That helped overcome a 39% shooting night from the field for the Wildcats.Garry Clark led Utah State with 13 points off the bench.The Aggies had 26 rebounds in the game. They shot 39% from the field.Utah State finished the season 29-7 overall.Arizona is now 34-2 on the season.Final score: Arizona 78, Utah State 66 Brayden Burries hits clutch shot for Wildcats vs Utah State lateBrayden Burries just hit a huge shot for Arizona after Utah State had pulled within 70-64.Burries, with the shot clock about to expire, nailed a long 3-poiniter to put the Wildcats up 73-64.There is 1:56 left in the second half.Arizona is 1:56 away from returning to the Sweet 16.Score: Arizona 73, Utah State 64 (1:56 left in second half) Jaden Bradley stepping up for Arizona vs Utah StateThe Wildcats have needed someone to step up amid their second-half struggles.Why not the Big 12 Player of the Year?Jaden Bradley has had some clutch baskets for Arizona late in this second half to keep the Wildcats in front of the Aggies.He now has a game-high 18 points.Motiejus Krivas has also been big in helping Arizona stay ahead. He has just five points in this game, but he has 13 rebounds, eight of which have come on offense.Arizona has 21 offensive rebounds in this game.Score: Arizona 66, Utah State 61 (3:24 left in second half) Utah State heating up vs ArizonaThe Utah State Aggies are just 7-for-27 from 3 in this game against Arizona.But they are 6-for-15 in the second half, including a huge 3-pointer just made by Drake Allen to pull the Aggies back within four.Score: Arizona 63, Utah State 59 (4:49 left in second half) Utah State putting pressure on Arizona in second half of March MadnessThis game has gotten very interesting.Jaden Bradley ended a 7:47 field-goal drought for Arizona with a magnificent driving layup after Utah State had pulled within 56-51.The Aggies then hit a 3-point to make it 58-54.Can Arizona hold on to beat Utah State?Arizona currently has a 60-54 lead after a tip in by Motiejus Krivas, his first field goal of the game.Score: Arizona 60, Utah State 54 (5:55 left in second half) Utah State on big run vs Arizona in second half of NCAA Tournament gameArizona Wildcats fans are suddenly not as confident as they were when their team had an 18-point lead earlier in the second half.Utah State has pulled withing 56-49 in this game, the closest it has been since it was 27-20 in first half.It is on a 16-5 run against the Wildcats.Garry Clark has been a big catalyst for the Aggies' comeback. He has 13 points on 6-for-7 shooting for Utah State off the bench. He also has six rebounds.Both are team highs for the Aggies.Koa Peat is on the Arizona bench with four fouls.There is 7:27 left in the second half.Score: Arizona 56, Utah State 49 (7:27 left in second half) Utah State clawing back vs Arizona in March MadnessThe Utah State Aggies have cut an 18-point deficit in the second half in half against the Wildcats.Arizona's lead is down to eight.This is getting interesting.Utah State is starting to put pressure on Arizona and it is paying off. Will the Wildcats adjust? They are starting to play a little tight.Score: Arizona 55, Utah State 47 (9:54 left in second half) Utah State goes on 6-0 run against ArizonaThe Aggies have gone on a little run of their own against Arizona.Utah State has scored six straight to pull within 51-39 in this second round NCAA Tournament game.You have to give the Aggies credit. They play hard.They are only shooting 37% from the field and 20% from 3-point range and have been outrebounded, 37-22, but continue to fight and are now only down 12.Score: Arizona 51, Utah State 39 (11:48 left in second half) Wildcats explode against Aggies in second-half runArizona just came out of a timeout on fire, scoring seven points over 1:01 of game time , while not allowing Utah State to score.Brayden Burries hit a 3-pointer, followed by a Jaden Bradley 17-foot jumper and a Burries 10-pouint jumper.Arizona now has an 18-point lead.Arizona is shooting 64% from the field in the second half.It has outscored Utah State 18-9.Score: Arizona 51, Utah State 33 (14:41 left in first half) Arizona continues to shoot 3s against Utah StateThe Arizona Wildcats aren't normally a high volume 3-point shooting team.But they are firing away in the NCAA Tournament.Arizona is now 5-for-12 on 3-point attempts in this game. The Wildcats have an 11-point lead early in the second half against the Aggies.Arizona is just 13-for-39 from the field overall.Score: Arizona 44, Utah State 33 (15:42 left in second half) Arizona takes 33-24 lead into half vs Utah State in second roundThe No. 1 Arizona Wildcats did not play well in the first half of their second-round NCAA Tournament game against No. 9 Utah State.But you wouldn't be able to tell by looking at the halftime score of the West Region game at Viejas Arena in San Diego.Arizona leads the Aggies after 20 minutes of play, 33-24, despite shooting 29% from the field.Arizona was able to get 27 rebounds in the first half, 12 on the offensive glass, to help get that 9-point lead.Utah State had 17 rebounds in the first half. The Aggies shot 11-for-30 from the field and 1-for-12 from 3-point range and have been smothered by Arizona's defense.Garry Clark leads Utah State with six points off the bench.Koa Peat has 11 points for Arizona to lead all scorers in the first half.Halftime score: Arizona 33, Utah State 24 Arizona, Utah State struggling from field in NCAA TournamentThe weather in San Diego is usually nice.But at Viejas Arena today, the teams are ice cold.Arizona is now just 7-for-25 from the field in this game, while Utah State is 8-for-24.Arizona holds a 27-18 lead because of 3-point shooting (4-for-9) and free throw shooting (9-for-13).Utah State is 1-for-10 from 3 and 1-for-2 from the free throw line and went 4:30 without scoring.Arizona's defense and rebounding margin (+7) is paying off in this game, helping the Wildcats overcome their shooting woes.Score: Arizona 27, Utah State 18 (3:45 left in first half) Utah State hanging around with Arizona in NCAA Tournament gameThe Arizona Wildcats have cooled off against Utah State, allowing the Aggies to inch closer in this game.A 10-point deficit is now down to six. Both teams are shooting 37% from the field.Seven Aggies have scored.Utah State has a 10-4 advantage in points in the paint in this game.Score: Arizona 22, Utah State 16 (7:50 left in first half) Koa Peat pacing Wildcats early vs Utah StateFreshman Koa Peat has six points on 2-for-3 shooting to lead the Wildcats early in this game.Arizona has an early 12-7 edge in rebounding and a 4-1 edge in offensive boards as they are taking advantage of their edge in size.The Wildcats have made 4-of-6 free throws. The Aggies are 1-for-2 from the free throw line.Score: Arizona 19, Utah State 12 (10:27 left in first half) Cold shooting start continues for Utah State vs ArizonaThe Aggies are going to have to start shooting the ball better if they want a chance to upset the Wildcats.Utah State is just 3-for-10 in this game.MJ Collins Jr. leads Utah State with five points on 2-for-3 shooting.Arizona is just 4-for-12 from the field itself, having cooled off. The Wildcats are 2-for-5 from the field, not helping their cause by settling for 3-point attempts instead of attacking the basket like fans are accustomed to see them do.Score: Arizona 12, Utah State 7 (13:47 left in first half) Arizona off to fast start vs Utah State in March MadnessThe No. 1 seeded Arizona Wildcats are off to a quick start against the No. 9 seeded Utah State Aggies.Arizona has a 10-2 lead at the first break in action at Viejas Arena in San Diego.Koa Peat has four early points for the Wildcats.Arizona is 3-for-7 from the field and 2-for-4 from 3. Utah State is just 1-for-5 from the field.The winner of this game takes on No. 4 seed Arkansas in the Sweet 16 on Thursday, March 26.Score: Arizona 10, Utah State 2 (16:31 left in first half) Arizona vs Utah State start time pushed backThe tip off for the Arizona vs Utah State game has been pushed back to 5:11 p.m. MST after the conclusion of the St. John's vs Kansas game at Viejas Arena.St. John's won a thriller to advance to the Sweet 16, 67-65, getting a layup at the buzzer to win it. What time is Arizona vs Utah State March Madness game?The Utah State vs Arizona NCAA Tournament March Madness second-round game is scheduled for 4:50 p.m. MST on Sunday, March 22. What channel is Utah State vs Arizona March Madness game on?The Arizona vs Utah State Round of 32 March Madness NCAA Tournament game can be seen on truTV. How can I stream Arizona vs Utah State March Madness game?Utah State vs Arizona can be streamed on Sling TV and other streaming services that carry truTV. Who are announcers for the Utah State vs Arizona March Madness game?Kevin Harlan will have the play-by-play call of the Arizona Wildcats vs Utah State Aggies NCAA Tournament Round of 32 game, with Robbie Hummel and Stan Van Gundy as the analysts and Lauren Shehadi as the reporter for the March Madness second-round matchup.
